headline: Guard note for utils.ts modifications
what_breaks: packages/math/src/point.ts — uses clamp and round functions
packages/math/src/angle.ts — depends on isCloseTo for angle comparisons
why: This file contains essential utility functions that are heavily utilized across multiple components in the math package. Changes here could impact the functionality of dependent files, potentially leading to widespread issues.
checklist: Review changes to clamp, round, and isCloseTo functions
Ensure no changes affect the expected output of average and isFiniteNumber
Check for impacts on dependent files, especially point and angle calculations
